scientific_integrity: The new contribution is the strict imbalance ordering of pairwise sign thresholds, not the already published exact component tuple moment formula. Exact finite enumeration supports, but does not replace, the complete analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Strict comparison is for second factorial cumulants; ordinary variance is not covered on the diagonal. Homogeneous G(n,p) only. Exact tuple moments were already known. Historical priority of the new strict imbalance-order theorem is not independently resolved.
title: Sharp imbalance ordering of pairwise component-count association in random graphs
